about: Real @arizeai/openinference-instrumentation-langchain spans (JavaScript) from @langchain/openai's ChatOpenAI, the counterpart of ../openinference-langchain with the same scenarios and responses, recorded through a scripted fetch: no network, no API keys, no rius SDK. LangChain stamps run records with Date.now() and OpenTelemetry reads performance.now(), so the recorder replaces both with clocks that advance one tick per reading (deterministicClock in _recording.mjs).

scenarios.chat: ChatOpenAI.invoke with a system and a user message, temperature and maxTokens set.
scenarios.tool_call: bindTools with tool_choice auto; the response is a tool call.
scenarios.tool_response: An AIMessage with the tool call and a ToolMessage with its result in the input, a text answer out.
scenarios.chain: A ChatPromptTemplate piped into ChatOpenAI: a RunnableSequence with the prompt-template and model spans under it.

openinference-js-langchain-4.1.4.json.verified: Re-recorded 2026-10-12 several times in a row from the lockfile's node_modules: byte-identical.
